actual_scope: Classify and count optimal second callees for exactly two resonant length-two Jordan blocks over every finite field.
scope_change_reason: Nicholas Stone's PR5556 explicitly leaves coupling between several Jordan blocks open. This is a written finite-field equality/counting theorem, not a proof-assistant caller binding or audit of that predecessor.
bottleneck_link: Algebraic interface side result: independent-block rigidity does not determine the coupled optimal-callee set. No native cost advantage or selected assumption is claimed.
stop_rule: Stop after the first coupled-pair theorem, exact bounded corroboration and one focused PR. Do not extend to larger block families.
evidence: PROOF.md gives the all-field theorem. verify.py checks 27 field/sign contexts, 215848 supported perturbations, 1819 accepted wrappers, all 65536 binary second maps including 20160 invertible ones, 175832 literal input basis columns, and 15 rejection controls. It emits a package-hash-bound receipt.
author: Nick Petalas
ai_assistance: Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

open_questions.question: How many optimal second callees survive for two length-two blocks with at least one eigenvalue squared different from one?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The singular resonant case has no determinant rejections; other blocks may couple through a nontrivial filter.
open_questions.first_step: Fix one concrete pair of distinct regular eigenvalues over F5 and write its complete square-zero quotient and determinant filter.
open_questions.blocked_by: The rank-two support reduction here uses both eigenvalues squared equal to one; the other quotient and its filter are not classified.

open_questions.question: Does one physically specified ordinary caller benefit from a coupled optimal map in this family?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Optimal agreement alone supplies no implementation saving.
open_questions.first_step: Choose one of the explicit single-entry coupled maps and price both callees with the actual correctness domain and restoration requirements.
open_questions.blocked_by: No native or physical cost model is supplied by this algebraic result.
